ReviewJobSettings.description:
How review jobs run. One record for the account, separate from `ReviewerSettings` (the reviewer's model, effort and instructions) so that type keeps the shape older clients decode.

Open on purpose (no `deny_unknown_fields`): later minors add fields here, and an older client must still decode a newer response. Every field has a default, so a record stored before a field existed loads with it.

autoReview.description: Review pull requests on their own when they open or get new commits. Off by default.

defaultHarnesses.description: The harnesses a review runs on when the caller names none. Empty means the first available of Claude, Codex and OpenCode.

fallbackHarnesses.description: Tried in order when a pass's harness fails (sign-in, usage limit, crash). Empty means a failed harness fails that pass.

handoff.description: Send finished reviews to the chat that wrote the pull request, which then works on them. Off by default.

incremental.description: A later review of a PR looks at the commits since its last posted review and remembers what was said and decided. Off by default.

maxReviewWorktrees.description: Review checkouts that may exist at once, 1 to 32. A job waits in the queue while they are all in use.

postMode.description: Draft first (the default) or post as soon as findings are drafted.

secondOpinion.description: Whether a review may run on two harnesses at once. Off (the default), a review runs on one.

skipDraftPrs.description: With auto-review on, leave draft pull requests until they are ready.

ReviewPostMode.description: Whether findings wait for triage or post as soon as they are drafted.

oneOf.description: Findings land in the pane; nothing reaches GitHub until a person posts.
Bridge posts the review as soon as it is drafted.
